name: nautobot__list_content_types
description:
List Django content types (``app_label.model``).

Useful when working with custom fields, tags, relationships, or
any feature scoped by content type.

name: nautobot__list_endpoints_in
description:
List the sub-endpoints inside an API category, e.g. ``dcim``.

Equivalent to GET ``/api/<category>/``.

name: nautobot__rest_list
description:
List objects from any Nautobot REST endpoint.

Args:
    endpoint: REST path under ``/api/``, e.g. ``/api/dcim/devices/``.
    filters: Optional filter parameters. Nautobot supports rich
        filtering, e.g. ``{"status": "active", "location": "ams01"}``.
        Use ``{"q": "core"}`` for free-text search where supported.
    limit: Page size (default 50, max 200 per Nautobot).
    offset: Page offset for manual pagination.
    paginate: If ``True``, walks every page automatically and
        returns a flat list (capped at ``max_records`` or the
        configured ``max_pagination_records``).
    max_records: Optional cap when ``paginate=True``.

name: nautobot__rest_get
description:
Fetch a single object: ``GET <endpoint>/<object_id>/``.

Args:
    endpoint: Collection endpoint, e.g. ``/api/dcim/devices/``.
    object_id: UUID, slug, or numeric id of the object.

name: nautobot__rest_create
description:
Create a new object via POST. Requires writes to be enabled.

Args:
    endpoint: Collection endpoint, e.g. ``/api/ipam/prefixes/``.
    data: Payload matching Nautobot's REST schema for that model.

name: nautobot__rest_update
description:
Update an object via PATCH (or PUT if ``partial=False``).

Requires writes to be enabled.

name: nautobot__rest_delete
description: Delete an object via DELETE. Requires writes to be enabled.

name: nautobot__list_devices
description:
List Nautobot devices.

Common filters: ``status``, ``location``, ``role``, ``device_type``,
``manufacturer``, ``platform``, ``tenant``, ``tag``, ``q``
(free-text search).

name: nautobot__get_device
description: Fetch a device by UUID or by name.

name: nautobot__get_device_interfaces
description: List interfaces on a device, with optional extra filters.

name: nautobot__list_locations
description: List Nautobot locations (sites, regions, rooms, etc. in 2.x).

name: nautobot__list_prefixes
description:
List prefixes. Filters: ``status``, ``vrf``, ``tenant``, ``role``,
``family`` (4 or 6), ``within``, ``within_include``, ``contains``.

name: nautobot__get_prefix
description: Fetch a prefix by UUID, or by CIDR string (e.g. ``10.0.0.0/24``).

name: nautobot__get_available_ips
description:
Return up to ``count`` available IPs inside a prefix.

This is a read-only preview of the next free addresses; it does
not allocate them. To actually allocate, ``rest_create`` an IP
address with the desired ``address`` and assign it.

name: nautobot__get_available_prefixes
description: List available child prefixes inside a parent prefix.

name: nautobot__list_ip_addresses
description:
List IP addresses. Filters include ``address``, ``parent``,
``status``, ``vrf``, ``tenant``, ``family``, ``role``.

name: nautobot__get_ip_address
description: Fetch an IP address by UUID or by ``address`` string.

name: nautobot__list_vlans
description:
List VLANs. Filters: ``vid``, ``name``, ``status``, ``location``,
``vlan_group``, ``tenant``, ``role``.

name: nautobot__list_vrfs
description: List VRFs.

name: nautobot__list_namespaces
description: List IPAM namespaces (Nautobot 2.x).

name: nautobot__list_tenants
description: List tenants. Filter by ``group``, ``q``.

name: nautobot__list_statuses
description:
List status objects. Optionally filter to a content type
(e.g. ``dcim.device``).

name: nautobot__list_tags
description: List tags. Optionally scope to a content type.

name: nautobot__list_roles
description: List roles (Nautobot 2.x unified Role model).

name: nautobot__graphql_query
description:
Run an arbitrary GraphQL query against ``/api/graphql/``.

Useful for cross-model queries that REST handles awkwardly, e.g.
"all interfaces of all devices in site X with their connected
cables and IPs".

Pair with ``graphql_introspect`` to discover available types.

name: nautobot__search_devices
description: Search devices by free-text query and common dimensions.

name: nautobot__search_ip_addresses
description: Search IP addresses.

name: nautobot__search_prefixes
description: Search prefixes. ``within`` accepts a CIDR to scope results.
